question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Mantain"** is incorrectly spelt. It should be** "Maintain"**. (बनाए रखना)

 
 
• **Example:** It is important to maintain a healthy diet for overall well-being.
 
 
 
• **"Maintain"** refers to keeping something in **its existing state or preserving it**. (बनाए रखना)
 
 
• **Example:** Engineers work hard to** maintain** the integrity of the structure.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Aquarium** (मछलीघर): A tank or pool in which aquatic animals and plants are kept.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were fascinated by the colorful fish in the **aquarium.**
 
 
 
• **Accurate** (सटीक): Correct in all details; exact.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist provided an **accurate** measurement of the sample.
 
 
 
• **Excellence** (उत्कृष्टता): The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.
 
 
• **Example:** The school is known for its academic **excellence.**
